services.name: AEM Assets Connector rollout for Figma designers
services.scope: Check that your client's AEM environment is on release 19149 or later, give the designers access to the agreed AEM Assets folders with the same company or federated Adobe ID they sign in with, roll out the AEM Assets Connector from the Figma Community, and test search, place, Check for updates and upload with the design team.
services.adobe_quote: AEM Assets integrates natively with Figma, which allows designers to directly access the assets stored in AEM Assets from within the Figma user interface.

source.title: Experience League: Integrate AEM Assets with Figma

connection_how: Your designers open AEM Assets in a panel inside Figma, place images, videos, GIFs and SVGs from it on the Figma canvas, check for newer versions in AEM, and save new or edited designs back to an AEM Assets folder.
product_facts: AEM Assets as a Cloud Service is Adobe's cloud-native solution for digital asset management and Dynamic Media. It helps you maximize the value of your digital assets across creation, management and delivery.
AEM Assets is the repository where your digital assets are managed, enriched and delivered.

People find the right asset through smart tags, customized metadata and enhanced search. Metadata forms let you add your own business-specific fields to an asset's details page, and we would agree those fields with you before the assets are loaded.
Search for the asset using Content Advisor within the connector panel.

The assets used in the current Figma document are compared to the assets that exist in AEM. Any updates are listed in a separate window. Click Update to get the updated asset from AEM into your Figma document.
Confirm that you are signing in to Figma with the same company or federated Adobe ID used for Experience Cloud and AEM Assets.
Minimum required AEM release version is 19149.
On your Figma home page, click Actions from the toolbar at the bottom of the canvas and search for Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Assets Connector in the search bar available in the dialog box.

services.name: Save-back folders and export settings for Figma designs
services.scope: Agree with your client's DAM owner which AEM Assets folders take the designs uploaded from Figma, the file format, scale and quality each use needs, how the files are named and when designers run Check for updates, then write the short guide the design team follows.
services.adobe_quote: The export configuration comprises the file format, scale, and quality.

In the dialog box, select either Selected Item or Page, specify a file or page name, define an export configuration and click Upload to upload the selected asset or the entire design to the destination folder.

The export configuration comprises the file format, scale, and quality. For example, if you select JPG as the file format, you can also define the image scale and quality. Similarly, if you select PNG as the file format, you can also define the image scale.
For exporting designs from Figma to AEM Assets, the supported formats are PNG, PDF, JPG, SVG.

services.name: Figma ad templates prepared for the GenStudio plugin
services.scope: Install the Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin from the Figma community marketplace for your client's designers, set up their Figma ad files as sections and frames at the sizes Meta, LinkedIn and Display accept, map the field roles with at least one image, and generate, translate and export test variations to GenStudio for Performance Marketing.
services.adobe_quote: Map Figma text elements to GenStudio for Performance Marketing fields, such as headline, body, on_image_text, and more.

source.title: Experience League: Figma plugin for GenStudio for Performance Marketing

connection_how: Your designers keep building ad templates in Figma. Adobe's Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin generates on-brand ad variations in those templates from your brands, personas and products, translates them, and sends them to GenStudio for Performance Marketing as experiences.
product_facts: GenStudio for Performance Marketing is an application built on Adobe's generative AI platform. It lets your marketing teams create, manage and optimize campaign content for ads and email.
GenStudio for Performance Marketing creates and optimizes the campaign content for ads and email.

We would start with your brand guidelines, which the generative AI uses as guardrails that guide content generation, and with templates that contain approved features and are optimized for specific channels.
Find and install the plugin from the Figma community marketplace.
The plugin requires the first two levels of your Figma document to follow this convention:
Generate new on-brand Meta, LinkedIn, or Display ad Experiences based on a brand, persona, product, and text prompt.
Translate generated Experiences into multiple languages.
Export generated Experiences to GenStudio for Performance Marketing.
You must map an image by assigning the image field role to at least one image element in your template.
A text field’s font must be available on your machine for replacement to occur during generation.
Select the Brand, Persona, and Product to use for the content generation.

services.name: Figma frames converted for GenStudio Photoshop
services.scope: Take the agreed Figma frames out of sections, convert them with the plugin to Photoshop documents for use with GenStudio Photoshop, open them in Photoshop, and rebuild with the designer what the conversion does not carry over, such as gradients, opacity percentages, strikethrough, superscript and subscript.
services.adobe_quote: You can use the Figma plugin to convert a Figma frame, multiple frames, or an entire document to Photoshop format and export it for use with GenStudio Photoshop.
services.license: GenStudio Photoshop from Adobe Exchange, in Photoshop 25.6.0 or later

connection_how: Your designers keep building ad templates in Figma. Adobe's Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin generates on-brand ad variations in those templates from your brands, personas and products, translates them, and sends them to GenStudio for Performance Marketing as experiences.

To perform this task, you need both the Figma plugin and GenStudio Photoshop.
Features such as strikethrough, superscript, subscript, opacity as percentages, gradients, and similar advanced properties are not yet supported.
Frames cannot be within a section during conversion.
Photoshop, minimum version 25.6.0
Download and update the plugin from the Creative Cloud Marketplace in Adobe Exchange.

services.name: Figma designs imported into Adobe Express
services.scope: Check that your client's Express users who import can use the Figma add-on (on enterprise plans through Admin Console roles), connect the Figma account of each person who imports, import the agreed frames with Native Import or Rasterize, fix the fonts the import summary marks Font Not Available and the shapes that came in as images, and hand the corrected designs over for templates.
services.adobe_quote: Native Import: Imports supported content as editable Adobe Express elements.

source.title: Adobe Help: Import Figma designs into Adobe Express

connection_how: Your designers' Figma pages, frames and layers come into Adobe Express through the Figma add-on, either as editable Express elements or as flattened images. The add-on only reads the Figma file.
product_facts: Adobe Express is where your teams create and edit images and videos for social posts, flyers, logos and more, from shared templates whose style controls keep them on brand.
Adobe Express lets your teams create content from shared templates that keep them on brand.

Roles and permissions are managed through the Admin Console, so your Enterprise admins give every team member the right level of access. Capabilities such as creating or editing templates and publishing to social media can be disabled for members.
The Figma add-on is available at no additional cost. You need valid Adobe Express and Figma accounts.

You need a Figma account with access to the file you want to import and access to Add-ons in Adobe Express. Full and Dev Figma licenses have unlimited access to the add-on capabilities, while Collab and View seats have daily limits.
Rasterize: Imports the selected content as a flattened image. You can move and scale the image, but you can't edit its individual elements.
You can use both import methods in the same design.

The add-on matches fonts by name when the same font is available in Figma and Adobe Express. If a font isn't available in Adobe Express, a fallback font is applied and identified as Font Not Available in the import summary.
Gradients, patterns, and certain masked or combined shapes can be imported as images to preserve their appearance.
For enterprise organizations, Adobe Express add-on access is managed through role-based access controls.

services.name: Custom models for Figma designers
services.scope: Check that each of your client's Figma designers has the plugin, Firefly access and the custom models they have created, then with each designer pick their models in Text to image, generate images and place them on the Figma canvas, and walk them through the prompt guide for each model.
services.adobe_quote: Select an Adobe or Partner model from the Model dropdown menu or choose a custom model you've created.

source.title: Adobe Firefly help: Use text to image to generate images in Figma

connection_how: In Text to image in Adobe's Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin for Figma, your designers pick a custom model they have created and place the generated images on the Figma canvas.
product_facts: Firefly Custom Models let you train Firefly generative models on your own images, so generated content reflects a specific visual style or subject. The models are private by default and designed for commercial use.
Firefly Custom Models generate content in your own visual style or of your own subject.
A system administrator entitles the people who train models. Models are private by default, and publishing and sharing are managed through Custom Model projects.
Trained models can be used to generate content in supported Adobe apps, including Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe Express, Firefly and GenStudio.
Select an Adobe or Partner model from the Model dropdown menu or choose a custom model you've created.
Select Text to image option in the plugin panel.
The generated images will appear in the plugin panel. You can add them to your canvas using any of these methods:
Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin installed in Figma
Active Adobe account with Firefly access
